title: G5: recovery — six independently testable failure classes
acceptance: F1 input/analysis/plan: skip corrupt/missing track and re-plan; no eligible corpus -> FAIL
F2 render/ffmpeg: never publish an incomplete master; keep the previous valid one; atomic publish via os.replace()
F3 artifact integrity: missing/corrupt master or wrong checksum/frame count -> block playback
F4 reader/disk starvation: record the error; must NOT masquerade as a normal EOF (player.py finally-sentinel bug)
F5 audio device/PortAudio: device loss / unopenable stream / underflow -> error + safe stop
F6 shutdown/interruption: Ctrl-C closes stream, reader, resources and records STOPPED
test covers each class
